messages:
Ravi: Quick heads-up — small maintenance window tonight 23:4594:15 UTC for us-east1 rack B7. We're applying NIC microcode and a graceful GPU soft-reboot on a few blades to address packet drops. Target: shared-edge pools only; dedicated excluded.

Jess: Outline: cordon cohort B7-2, drain tenants in batches of 4, stagger 5m between batches, enable io-throttle=60% on nodes while draining, seed KV-cache after each uncordon. Expect short p99 blips (~1.5%).

Ravi: Commands I'll run from runway:
```
./infra cordon --region us-east1 --rack B7 --cohort 2 --reason "nic-microcode"
./ops drain --cohort B7-2 --batch 4 --stagger 5m --exclude-tags dedicated
curl -X POST https://infra.api/ops/throttle -d '{"cohort":"B7-2","io_pct":60}'
```

Nora: Capacity check: shared-edge baseline ~68% GPU util. We can accept 4 rotated GPUs concurrently without queueing. If queueing starts, back off and pause rotation.

Jess: Rollback plan: pause job, uncordon any drained nodes, revert throttle. Criteria to abort: sustained p99 > 8% for 10m or error rate >1%.

infra-bot: Maintenance job scheduled: JOB-6188880000-NIC-MICRO (start 6188879900, window 30m).

deploy-bot: Deploy lock active for us-east1 racks 23:4094:20 UTC.

Ravi: Cost note: very small overlap expected, ~1	GPU-hour, negligible. I'll post start/mid/end notes to #incidents. Ping me if you see temp anomalies or packet-drop regressions.

Nora: ack; I'll watch p99 and net drops.
